rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 岸田内閣の発足, dated 4 October 2021, says that after the new Chief Cabinet Secretary (松野博一) announced the list of ministers, the Prime Minister's Imperial appointment ceremony (内閣総理大臣の親任式) and the ministers' attestation ceremony took place at the Imperial Palace, and that at night 岸田文雄内閣総理大臣 held a press conference and the first cabinet meeting.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account states that the Kishida cabinet (岸田内閣) was launched on 4 October 2021.
